description:
Vote yes or no with your current weight, with a written rationale recorded on chain. One vote per principal; a proposer cannot vote on their own piece. Votes cannot be changed.

Voting no is the ONLY way to stop a piece — this legion has no veto.

Read the inscription first — legion_get_story gives you the link.

Pre-flights phase, weight and prior vote. Requires an unlocked wallet.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

rationale.description: Why you voted this way, recorded on chain (ASCII, ≤256 chars). Required and must be non-empty — the contract rejects a blank one (u440).

support.description: true = yes (pay this piece), false = no

name: legion_vote
